AI-backed talent intelligence platform
Skillate is an AI-backed talent intelligence platform to make hiring easy, fast, and transparent. The repetitive and voluminous work of manually screening & short-listing candidates is completely eliminated. NLP and deep learning algorithms make the matching recommendations highly accurate and capable of reinforced learning of the company hiring patterns to enhance the results. This robust application will also be able to help companies in campus hirings, recruitment drives, and internal staffing.
Empowered with AI, the recruiters can close positions quickly, with the best-fit candidates and a reduced dependency on external agencies. With full utilization, Skillate can reduce the time to hire by more than 50% and cost per hire by more than 30%.
Skillate is envisioned as a product that can consistently address recruitment inefficiencies and help companies build stronger teams.
